new.title: Artist photos on requests
new.text: When you ask for an artist rather than one album, the request shows their photo.

fixed: Album covers on the Requests page show up again: a slow answer from the cover archive no longer leaves them blank for a week.

new.title: Measuring makes way for new music
new.text: While Shelf measures songs in the background, a rescan or newly added music no longer has to wait for it to finish: measuring steps aside and carries on afterwards.

fixed: With measuring set to “Only at night”, new music is picked up during the day again.
A damaged song can no longer stall partway through when it’s converted for streaming.
People signed in through a reverse proxy can use Connect, and names like alice@example.com get an account.
Removing someone from a Subsonic app also disconnects their devices from Connect.
Similar artists and songs that sound alike answer faster in Subsonic apps on big libraries.

new.title: Every Subsonic app feature
new.text: Apps like Symfonium, Feishin and DSub now get everything they can ask for: your podcasts, share links, internet radio, songs that sound alike, and music converted to MP3, Opus, AAC or FLAC from any point in a song.

new.title: API keys
new.text: Newer music apps can sign in with a key instead of your username and password. Make one per app in Settings, and remove it to sign that app out.

new.title: Faster with big libraries
new.text: Home, Mixes and artist pages open much faster on large libraries, and the server uses far less memory. Your daily mixes are made ahead of time, so they’re ready when you open them.

new.title: Docker and Raspberry Pi
new.text: The server now comes as a Docker image for PCs, servers and Raspberry Pi, with a guide for setting it up behind your own web address.

new.title: When to measure songs
new.text: Choose whether Shelf measures new songs any time, only at night or never, in the admin dashboard. Handy on a small computer.

new.title: Sign in through your proxy
new.text: If a reverse proxy like Authelia or Authentik already signs people in, Shelf can trust it instead of asking again.

fixed: Apps signed in with an app password or API key can no longer change passwords or accounts: that now needs your real password.
A page that hit a server problem now says what went wrong instead of showing [object Object].

new.title: Shelf 1.0
new.text: Shelf’s first major release: your music, podcasts and playlists on your own server, on the web, your computer and your Android phone.

new.title: Your Episodes
new.text: Save any podcast episode with the bookmark next to it, and it waits for you in Your Episodes, pinned in your Library. Filter by Unplayed, Downloaded or In progress.

new.title: Download episodes
new.text: Every episode has a download button: keep it on your phone or computer and listen with no connection.

new.title: Request music from Home
new.text: In the Android app, Request music now sits right on Home, so asking for an artist or album you’re missing is one tap away.

fixed: In the Android app, tapping the tab you’re already in (say Library, after opening an album from it) takes you back to its first page instead of leaving you where you were.
In the Android app, pages that are still loading or couldn’t load keep their Back button, and the artist page’s Back is easier to see.

new.title: Podcasts
new.text: Follow any show and listen in Shelf: search for it, or paste its link from Podbean, Apple Podcasts or anywhere with a feed. Your shows sit in your Library, new episodes show up on Home, and Shelf remembers where you stopped on every device.

new.title: Follow artists
new.text: Tap Follow on an artist’s page. Once you follow someone, your Library shows just them and their albums instead of everything on the server (you can still show everything).

new.title: A Home that knows what you like
new.text: New rows like “More like” your favourite artists and “From artists you follow”, and the rows you use most move up over time.

new.title: Requests
new.text: Missing something? Ask for an artist or an album, with suggestions from MusicBrainz as you type. Everyone sees the list, and a request ticks itself off when the music arrives.

new.title: Reorder the queue on the web
new.text: Songs still to come have a grip: drag it to move the song, or tap it and use the arrow keys. Works on the Queue page and in the side panel, even when the music plays on another device.

new.title: Secure connections
new.text: When your server has a secure address, Shelf moves to it by itself, still signed in, so passwords and music are encrypted away from home.

new.title: Secure address
new.text: Give Shelf an https address for people away from home with one button (Tailscale Funnel), or use your own domain. Admin → Secure address.

new.title: Import playlists
new.text: Bring a playlist over from Spotify or YouTube (paste the link, or share it to Shelf on Android), another music player, or a list of songs. Shelf finds the songs in your library. Playlists → Import.

new.title: The same recording, by its sound
new.text: Library health now listens for the same song under another name: an untagged copy, or one album with a song on it twice. Admin → Library health.

new.title: Webhooks
new.text: Tell Home Assistant or another program when your music starts or pauses, a listen counts, or new albums arrive. Admin → Webhooks.

new.title: What’s new
new.text: After each update, this window shows what’s new and what’s fixed, once. It’s in Settings too.

fixed: On Xiaomi phones, Shelf updates itself from inside the app again.
The admin dashboard shows again in the Android app, and gets the whole screen.

new.title: Smart playlists
new.text: Playlists that pick their own songs by rules, like “not played in 6 months” or “added this week”, and keep themselves up to date. Playlists → Smart playlist.

new.title: Long tracks pick up where you stopped
new.text: Live sets, DJ mixes and audiobooks of 15 minutes or more remember your place, on every device.

new.title: Share links
new.text: Send a song, album or playlist to someone without an account: they listen in their browser. In the menu, when your admin has turned them on.

new.title: Other music apps
new.text: Apps made for Subsonic, like Symfonium, Amperfy and Feishin, can play from Shelf. Settings → Other music apps.

new.title: Daily backups
new.text: The server keeps a copy of accounts, Favourites, playlists and history every day, ready to restore.

new.title: Library health
new.text: Albums without covers (Shelf can find them), gaps in track numbers, songs twice, and lossless files made from an MP3.

fixed: FLAC songs that wouldn’t play on Android phones play again.
Android plays your files as they are by default, on mobile data and for downloads.
A song that can’t be played is skipped, with a message, instead of the music stopping.
On Android, a queue started on mobile data switches to full quality on Wi-Fi.
Shuffle keeps its order through crossfades and Mix.
